patients.summary: Healthy elementary school teacher who joined in 2023 and had her first pregnancy in 2025-26. Ten days after an uncomplicated delivery she was admitted for postpartum psychosis and started olanzapine, then had right lactational mastitis and postpartum depression treated with sertraline and therapy; she is improving at today.

events.reason: New patient, establish care and physical

documents.title: New Patient Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
28 yo woman, elementary school teacher, here to establish. Her old PCP left practice in the spring and she'd rather not start over in a big group. No complaints today.

PMH: none. No surgeries. Meds: none. Allergies: NKDA.
FH: father with type 2 diabetes. Mother had depression after her second pregnancy. Maternal aunt has bipolar I disorder.
SH: married, lives in Northampton. Teaches elementary school. Never smoked. Alcohol a drink or two a month at most. No drug use. Walks most evenings.
GYN: regular cycles. Last Pap 2021 at prior office, she believes normal.
ROS: negative in full.

Exam: vitals as charted. Well, pleasant. HEENT clear, TMs normal. Neck supple, thyroid normal size, no adenopathy. Heart RRR, no murmur. Lungs clear bilaterally. Abd soft, nontender, no masses. Ext without edema. Skin without concerning lesions. Neuro grossly intact. Mood euthymic.

PHQ-9: 2.

A/P: Healthy adult, new to the practice.
- Baseline CBC, CMP, lipids. A1c given father's diabetes.
- HIV and hep C one-time screens, she agreed.
- Records requested from prior PCP for Pap and immunization history.
- Flu shot in the fall here.
- Physical yearly.

documents.title: Your recent labs
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Isabelle, everything from Tuesday's blood work came back normal: blood counts, kidney and liver tests, cholesterol, and your A1c is in the normal range. HIV and hepatitis C screens were negative. Nothing to change. Enjoy the rest of the summer before school starts.

documents.title: Prior Primary Care Records
documents.author: MA
documents.body:
Records received from prior primary care office, 22 pages, scanned to media.

Abstracted:
- Healthy, no chronic problems on their list. No medications. NKDA.
- Pap 06/2021: NILM.
- Immunizations: childhood series documented as complete. Tdap 2016. Annual flu shots most years.
- Last physical there 06/2021, unremarkable.

documents.title: Immunization
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Came in after school for flu vaccine. No fever today, no prior vaccine reactions, NKDA. Influenza quadrivalent 0.5 mL IM left deltoid. VIS given. Waited 15 min, no reaction.

documents.title: COVID vaccine
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hi, I got the new COVID shot at the pharmacy near school Saturday (Pfizer). Wanted it in my record. Arm sore one day, otherwise fine.

documents.title: RE: COVID vaccine
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Thanks, Isabelle. Added to your immunization record.

documents.body: Pt called, parent-teacher conferences moved to tomorrow morning. Cancelled 3/5 physical. Rebooked for April vacation week, 4/16 at 9:00.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual exam, on school vacation this week. Feels well. Sleeping fine, busy year with a big class. No meds. NKDA. Never smoker, rare alcohol.

ROS negative.

Exam: vitals as charted, weight steady. Alert, well-appearing. HEENT normal. Thyroid not palpable. Lungs clear. Heart regular, no murmur. Breasts symmetric without masses, nipples normal, no axillary nodes. Abdomen soft. Pelvic: external genitalia normal, vagina and cervix normal, Pap collected. Bimanual without masses or tenderness. Skin clear. Mood good, PHQ-9 1.

A/P: Well adult.
- Pap today, 3 years since the last. Once she is 30 we can switch to co-testing every 5 years.
- CBC, CMP.
- Tdap was 2016, good until 2026.
- Flu shot this fall.
- Asked about pregnancy plans, not this year she says. Will revisit.

documents.title: Pap and labs
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Isabelle, your Pap was normal, so the next one is due in 3 years. Blood counts and chemistry were normal too. See you next spring.

documents.title: Immunization
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Flu vaccine, trivalent, 0.5 mL IM right deltoid. Screening negative, feeling well. VIS reviewed. Observed 15 minutes, tolerated well.

documents.title: covid shot
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Got this year's COVID booster (Moderna) at the pharmacy on Saturday the 19th, for my chart.
